approval.statement: Утверждаю R1-010 Public Inquiry Domain Contract версии 0.1.0-proposed на SHA 68fb60f87c7821044939dd5d95f8e67e6bb73685. Принимаю OD-010-01…05 в редакциях docs/plans/R1-010-owner-decisions.md.
approval.scope: Approval authorizes isolated R1-010B implementation after contract integration. It does not authorize production migrations, deployment, production personal-data collection, scanner provisioning or live permission grants.

finalization.description: Owner-approved R1-010 Contract Amendment 02 adds L0 default-deny staff original downloads. CLEAN alone is insufficient; current authorization and document binding are checked before a safe 404, storage is never opened, and no success download audit is emitted until separate exact-original eligibility is approved and implemented. Existing bytes, metadata, safety state and historical audit are preserved. Amendment 01 and all OD-010-01…05 rules remain unchanged.

amendments.approvalStatement: Owner approved capability-only upload routes, preserved the public create receipt without Inquiry UUID, required unique capability-hash lookup and one-way capability revocation through the authorized pre-quote close, and confirmed MVP_SAFE 10 MiB/file and ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTS 50 MiB/file with an OpenAPI ceiling of 52428800 bytes and server-selected profile/quota limits.
changes: One-way server-side capability revocation by clearing hash and expiry in the authorized pre-quote close transaction; no public or additional staff route
UploadIntentReceipt.data.maxBytes is bounded by the declared size, selected profile and remaining Inquiry and source/day quotas; streaming limit remains enforced
preserves: Public create receipt contains only publicReference, createdAt and message
MVP_SAFE=10 MiB/file; ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTS=50 MiB/file; maximum OpenAPI schema value=52428800 bytes
OD-010-01…05 behavior apart from these explicit corrections
RBAC, lifecycle, personal-data rules, upload formats and limits, quarantine and launch gates
amendments.scope: No production migration, deployment, real permission grant or public launch authorization.

changes: CLEAN scan state no longer authorizes staff original download

Until separately approved and implemented exact-original eligibility exists, all staff downloads including historical CLEAN return safe 404 after authorization and document relation checks, before storage open or bytes
No success download AuditEvent; preserve original bytes, metadata, safety state and historical audit
Retain current 401/403, FILE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE and infrastructure error handling
preserves: No schema, RBAC grant, route, worker, scanner, storage or public DTO changes
amendments.scope: No production inventory, migration, deployment, external gate change, mixed-version/old-binary operation or CLEAN enablement.
